messages:
anya (Docs): Heads-up: we're normalizing a param name across the API + SDKs — `response_format` -> `output_format`. This is a docs-first change to reduce confusion across languages. We'll provide a compatibility shim in SDKs for a limited window so most customers won't see immediate breakage. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/874 and migration checklist: https://go.redwood.dev/sdk-param-change

sam (Eng SDK): Quick Q — timeline? is this considered a breaking change for hosted API users or only for SDK callers?

anya (Docs): Not immediate break for hosted API — the server will accept both keys during the grace period. SDKs will ship the shim in a patch release this week so JS/Py/Go samples work out of the box. Planned enforcement (remove old alias) is 2026-06-15. We'll publish the deprecation notice + changelogs and add console banners. :loudspeaker:

jordan (Product): We'll schedule customer comms next Tue. @sanjay can you coordinate with enterprise accounts for Dedicated/Private upgrade windows?

sanjay (Sales/Enterprise): Yep — for Private customers we'll treat this as opt-in removal. We'll ship migration instructions and a runtime toggle for on-prem packs; no forced removal unless customers opt in.

docs-bot: PR 874 merged to `main` by anya — checklist passed (docs build, links, spellcheck). CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234 ✅

mike (DevEx): I'll update the quickstart and in-repo examples (js/python/go). Expect PRs by EOD. Also adding a linter rule to warn on `response_format` usages in examples and guides.

kate (Support): Draft customer blurb ready: "Heads up: we renamed `response_format` to `output_format`. Both will work until June 15, 2026. See migration guide: https://go.redwood.dev/sdk-param-change" — want me to send this to the release list?

anya (Docs): Please send it to the release list and include the private/Dedicated note. Use the template in the PR for the subject + migration steps.

sam (Eng SDK): One more — telemetry/metrics question: will the shim preserve existing telemetry labels? We don't want to spike eval/regression alerts when parameter names change.

anya (Docs): Shim preserves telemetry naming (old param is mapped to new internal name server-side and SDK-side for metrics). We'll add unit tests to confirm and update the eval harness.

anya (Docs): Example migration snippet (to include in migration guide):
```
# old
client.generate(..., response_format='json')

# new
client.generate(..., output_format='json')
```

mike (DevEx): Nice. I'll also add automated CI grep to flag any leftover `response_format` in future PRs.

jordan (Product): Thanks team — landing plan: patch shim release this week, docs + console banners tomorrow, customer email Tue, and enforcement 2026-06-15 unless a customer requests an extended window.

anya (Docs): I'll update the PR with the full timeline and add a short FAQ. Ping me if you want review on the email draft. :wave:
